name: What is doorway widening and why would I need it?

mainEntity.name: What is doorway widening and why would I need it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Doorway widening involves modifying an existing door frame and surrounding wall structure to create a wider opening. This service is often needed to improve accessibility for individuals using wheelchairs, walkers, or other mobility aids. It can also enhance the flow and aesthetic appeal of a home, making rooms feel more open, or accommodate larger furniture and appliances during moves or renovations. Our team can assess your current doorways and recommend optimal solutions.
acceptedAnswer.description: Doorway widening expands existing door frames, often for improved accessibility or to enhance home flow and accommodate large items. It involves modifying the door frame and wall.
